arcade.mdd: The experiment is ready, assistant. Take a seat.
arcade.lobby.hint: Pick an experiment. Empty seats are filled by bots.
arcade.label.name: Name
arcade.aria.name: Name to use in the arcade
arcade.game.reflex.name: Reaction Test
arcade.game.reflex.desc: One order, a few seconds. Shorter every round
arcade.game.gomoku.name: Gomoku
arcade.game.gomoku.desc: Line up five on a nine-by-nine board
arcade.copy.done: Link copied — paste it and they walk in
arcade.wait.guest: You're in. The round starts when the host begins
arcade.game.four.name: Four in a Row
arcade.game.memory.name: Matching
arcade.game.memory.desc: Flip and remember. A match buys another turn
arcade.game.hitblow.name: Hit and Blow
arcade.game.hitblow.desc: Crack a hidden 3-digit number in ten
arcade.game.reversi.name: Reversi
arcade.game.dots.name: Dots and Boxes
arcade.game.dots.desc: Draw lines, close boxes. A box buys another turn
arcade.game.speed.name: Speed
arcade.game.speed.desc: No turns. One rank up or down — first hand wins it
arcade.game.slide.name: Sliding Puzzle
arcade.game.slide.desc: Same scramble for everyone — first to solve takes it. Solo works too
arcade.game.ultimate.name: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe
arcade.game.ultimate.desc: Where you play decides where they must
arcade.game.yacht.name: Yacht Dice
arcade.game.yacht.desc: Roll three times, keep what you like, fill twelve boxes
arcade.game.checkers.name: Checkers
arcade.game.checkers.desc: Jump to capture; reach the back row to crown
arcade.checkers.stale: Long stretch with nothing happening — a draw
arcade.game.blackjack.name: Blackjack
arcade.game.blackjack.desc: Get close to 21. Go over and you're out
arcade.game.president.name: President
arcade.game.president.desc: Same rank, same count, higher. The 2 beats everything
arcade.game.dominoes.name: Dominoes
arcade.game.dominoes.desc: Match the open ends. Can't play — draw
arcade.game.curling.name: Curling
arcade.game.curling.desc: Slide close to the button. Knocking others out is fair game
arcade.game.bowling.name: Bowling
arcade.game.bowling.desc: Knock down ten. Three frames, real scoring
arcade.game.pool.name: Pool
arcade.game.pool.desc: Cue ball into pockets. Sink one, shoot again
arcade.game.darts.name: Darts
arcade.game.darts.desc: Stop the swinging aim. Take 101 down to exactly zero
arcade.game.airhockey.name: Air Hockey
arcade.game.airhockey.desc: Slide to block and score. First to five
arcade.game.highlow.name: High-Low
arcade.game.highlow.desc: Higher or lower. Doubles on a streak, zero on a miss
arcade.game.nim.name: Nim
arcade.game.nim.desc: Take any number from one row. Take the last and you lose
arcade.game.hanabi.name: Fireworks
arcade.game.hanabi.desc: Only you cannot see your hand. Tell each other, build together
arcade.hanabi.pickHint: Pick your card, or tap a card to tell them
arcade.game.wordchain.name: Word Chain
arcade.game.wordchain.desc: Start with the last letter. Run dry and you're out
arcade.game.lineup.name: Line Up
arcade.game.lineup.desc: Answer in secret, then guess everyone's order
arcade.lineup.questions: How well do you handle spicy food|How much screen time a day|Morning person (100 = morning)|How easily you talk to strangers|How much you plan ahead|How well you handle horror|How patient you are|How much you like new things
arcade.game.minesweeper.name: Minesweeper
arcade.game.minesweeper.desc: Same field, a race. Step on one and only you are out
arcade.game.liars.name: Liar's Dice
arcade.game.liars.desc: Call the whole table from your own dice. It need not be true
arcade.game.twenty.name: 20 Questions
arcade.game.twenty.desc: Narrow it with yes or no. One holds the answer, the rest ask
arcade.twenty.questions: Is it alive?|Did people make it?|Is it indoors?|Can you hold it?|Can you eat it?|Does it move?|Does it float?|Does it make sound?|Is it colorful?|Do you see it outside?
arcade.twenty.missed: A guess, and it was wrong
arcade.game.snake.name: Snake Race
arcade.game.snake.desc: Swipe to turn. Everyone's trail is a wall
arcade.game.onestroke.name: One Stroke
arcade.game.onestroke.desc: Trace every line without lifting. Same figure, a race
arcade.game.fishing.name: Fishing
arcade.game.fishing.desc: Wait, then pull on the bite. Big ones are rare
